meta_description: Pocket Glance is a calm, private budget tracker for Android. Track spending, budgets, subscriptions and savings goals with no bank login and no ads. Your financial data stays on your phone.
meta_og_description: Track spending, budgets and subscriptions. Private, with no bank login needed.
theme_label: Switch between light and dark mode
hero_lead: A calm, private budget tracker for Android. No bank login. No account. No ads.
feat_title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
feat_lead: Budgeting that stays small and quiet, so you actually keep doing it.

s3_li1: Log for today, yesterday or any date

g2_alt: Home screen in the dark theme
p_title: Your money stays on your phone.
p_lede: We have no accounts and no servers that receive your transactions, so we cannot see your finances.
f1_d: No account, no bank login, no access to your SMS or contacts.
f2_d: Fingerprint, face or PIN. Android checks it; the app never receives it.
f3_d: To a file on your phone, or encrypted to your own Google Drive.
f4_d: Usage and crash reports can be switched off in Settings at any time.
